summary: A 1924 pole platform became a 40-ft pole tower with an L-4 cab in 1934 on the Kaniksu National Forest; destroyed in 1959. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 40-ft pole tower (1934), after a 1924 pole platform
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1959. No source read describes what remains at the site.

events.note: 30-ft pole platform. Forest Lookouts dates it c.1924.
40-ft pole tower with L-4 cab built, after the 1924 platform.
Blowup on the Quartz Creek fire that threatened the lookout. The year is inferred from 'last summer' in a January 1927 Forest Worker item.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com lists two periods, 1924-1934 and 1934-1959. The 1924 platform and the 1934 tower are both consistent with that and with the other two pages.
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no documented staff history. Forest Lookouts quotes a 1936 Newport Miner item that places Jay Pearce at the lookout. The item is one mention, not a staffing history.

notes_for_editor: Structure history agrees across three pages. The 1926 fire date is inferred from 'last summer' in a January 1927 item. Staffing (1936) and the fire item are single-source. The status label 'Removed' on Forest Lookouts is unexplained. Nothing describes the site today. Record height_m is 9.1 m, which matches the 30-ft 1924 platform; the 1934 tower was 40 ft (about 12.2 m), so the editor should decide the height. The photo url is the catalog item page, because the direct JPEG link was not captured; no photo year is given; the catalog gives a 1930-1950 range, which the caption carries. Forest name follows the pages, not checked against current usage.
